caption: The console: one strip per input, a device or a program, with filters, gate, compressor, its sends and a fader; the three buses on the right.
The routing matrix: a crosspoint sends an input to a bus, its dial sets the level, PRE takes the signal before the fader.
Per bus: a four-band equalizer with its curve, a compressor and a lookahead limiter.
The event log: a device that left, one that came back, and a change pult refused, with the reason.
